import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    words = data[1:]
    
    merged_word = words[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        word = words[i]
        max_overlap = 0
        for j in range(1, min(len(merged_word), len(word)) + 1):
            if merged_word[-j:] == word[:j]:
                max_overlap = j
        merged_word += word[max_overlap:]
    
    print(merged_word)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
